- The re-install / update story reads: bump `@objectstack/skills` with the other `@objectstack/*` packages, then re-run the sync.
- `check:doc-route-spelling`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:doc-authoring`, the docs link check and `pnpm check:skill-docs` green; the `skills/README.md` hunk, if touched, keeps the generated index block untouched.
